description: This class is a singleton validator for integer values, parsing string inputs to validate they can be converted to integers; if not, it throws a specific exception.

classes.name: IntValueValidator
classes.description: A singleton class extending AbstractHeaderValueValidator responsible for validating that a CharSequence can be parsed into an integer. Throws DittoHeaderInvalidException if parsing fails.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of IntValueValidator.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Attempts to parse the provided CharSequence as an integer; throws exception if parsing fails.
